provenance_policy: External primary work motivates an independent SENS semantics experiment. No claim that 1983/1986 papers implement SENS or add Lisp 1.5 opcodes. No foreign code copied.

source.title: James F. Allen, Maintaining Knowledge about Temporal Intervals, Communications of the ACM 26(11), 1983

rows.signature: ((a_start,a_end),(b_start,b_end)) -> one of 13 tagged Allen relations, exact rational endpoints a_start<a_end and b_start<b_end
rows.semantic_law: Exactly one of BEFORE, MEETS, OVERLAPS, STARTS, DURING, FINISHES, EQUALS and their six distinct converse relations for two nonempty intervals; MEETS differs from a positive temporal gap; swapping operands yields the specified inverse.
falsifiers: Coincident endpoints MEETS must never be BEFORE
All 13 mutually exclusive relations appear on small exhaustive ordered endpoint samples
Swapping intervals returns exact converse; EQUALS is self-converse
Empty/reversed interval must raise an explicit invalid-input outcome, not a fabricated relation
rows.duplicate_review: Exact-name absent from D1-D9 and 634 canonical D10 candidates. Strong expressibility concern: 13-way predicate derivable from exact rational ordering + conditional control; D2 retains control ownership. Core-vs-library review mandatory.

source.title: Johan de Kleer, An assumption-based TMS, Artificial Intelligence 28(2), 1986, pp.127–162

rows.signature: (left_label,right_label,nogoods) -> ordered minimal consistent finite assumption environments; each assumption is an exact nonnegative integer ID
rows.semantic_law: Form all unions of one left support and one right support. Discard any union that contains a known inconsistent nogood as a subset. Remove strict supersets of surviving support environments. Return the antichain sorted first by support cardinality then lexicographically. Empty environment () denotes unconditional support and differs from no support alternatives ().
falsifiers: No returned support can contain any nogood subset
No two returned environments may be strict subsets of one another
Order/duplicate of input supports may not change canonical result
An empty family of alternatives is not the same as one empty support
rows.duplicate_review: Exact-name absent from D1-D9 and 634 canonical D10 candidates; possible composition using D6 UNION, subset predicate, proof provenance and ordinary filtering. Must prove an irreducible language-level observer rather than an application ATMS library function.
